The '''Sathiemon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sathiemon]],<ref name="Twitter" /> which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least 2 [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sathiemon system was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square Q-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
